name: cloud-superapp-mcp
description: MCP + HTTP faces over the Android constellation's on-device debug API
_doc: This root manifest exists so a single node_modules at /app resolves for every package in the tree. lib-mcp, mcps-apps and cloud-superapp-mcp all import the SDK, and Node walks UP from the IMPORTING file — a node_modules beside only the entry point leaves them unresolved (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND). The per-package package.json files stay for local/stdio use.
